newsitem.title: CANADA: Suncor lowers Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Suncor lowers Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Suncor Energy Inc said on Wednesday it lowered the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$2.00/cubic metre or C$0.32/barrel, to C$157.00/cubic metre or C$24.96/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$147.00/cubic metre, or C$23.37/barrel Midale at Cromer C$131.00/cubic metre, or C$20.83/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
